name: Probe R22 A
mExpression: let Raw = AnalysisServices.Database("SSASPROD","BIQLTabular",[ Query = "EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS( FILTER( Sales, TRIM(Sales[Record Type]) = ""Sales Detail"" && Sales[Cancelled_Flag] = 0 && ( Sales[Order Num] IN { 1112576, 2404315, 2408832, 1193, 19001973, 19002384, 19002622, 20000017, 1028630, 1057757, 1058396, 2755409, 2732783, 2645790, 26001448 } ) ), ""OrderCo"", Sales[Order Company], ""OrderNum"", Sales[Order Num], ""LineNum"", Sales[Line Num], ""Item2nd"", Sales[Item Num 2nd], ""OrderType"", Sales[Order Type], ""OrderTypeDesc"", Sales[Order Type Desc], ""LineType"", Sales[Line Type], ""ActiveOT"", Sales[Filter - Active Order Types], ""ExclBudget"", Sales[Exclude Budget Data], ""CcyBase"", Sales[Currency Code Base], ""CcyFrom"", Sales[Currency Code From], ""LocalCcy"", Sales[LocalCurrency], ""CcyMode"", Sales[Currency Mode], ""XRateUSD"", Sales[Exchange Rate USD], ""XRateEUR"", Sales[Exchange Rate EUR], ""CFUSD"", Sales[ConversionFactorUSD], ""CFEUR"", Sales[ConversionFactorEUR], ""CFLC"", Sales[ConversionFactorLC], ""SpotRate"", Sales[Currency Conversion Spot Rate], ""Net"", Sales[AmountOrderNet], ""NetUSD"", Sales[AmountOrderNetUSD], ""NetEUR"", Sales[AmountOrderNetEUR], ""BOAmt"", Sales[BackOrderedExtendedAmount], ""BOAmtEUR"", Sales[BackOrderedExtendedAmountEUR], ""ExtPriceNet"", Sales[AmountExtendedPriceNet], ""PromDate"", Sales[Promised Shipment Date] )" ]), Data = Table.TransformColumnNames(Raw, each if Text.StartsWith(_, "[") and Text.EndsWith(_, "]") then Text.Middle(_, 1, Text.Length(_) - 2) else _) in Data
